slots.name: maximum term limit for governor
slots.sentence: Gov. Laura Kelly, a Democrat with a unique political brand, is barred by law from seeking a third term.

slots.name: Republican nominee for governor
slots.sentence: Republican voters selected Ty Masterson, the influential leader of the Kansas Senate, as their nominee for governor on Tuesday, The Associated Press said.

slots.name: Ty Masterson's years of experience in the Kansas Capitol
years since Laura Kelly's first election
slots.sentence: Ms. Kelly won her first term eight years ago in another midterm election with Mr. Trump in the White House.

slots.name: stance on legalizing marijuana
slots.sentence: Mr. Masterson, Mr. Sarnecki and Mr. Schwab all said they opposed legalizing marijuana.

slots.name: candidate dropout status
slots.sentence: Former Gov. Jeff Colyer dropped out of the primary after Mr. Trump endorsed Mr. Masterson.

slots.name: Trump endorsement status
slots.sentence: The aide argued that the attacks have been ineffective against the state Senate president, especially given he’s the Trump-endorsed candidate in a state the president won three times.

slots.name: Ty Masterson's stance on infrastructure and local control
slots.sentence: Masterson has said that “folks build here on our terms, or they don’t build here,” and that local communities should be in charge of deciding whether they want the infrastructure.

slots.name: Ty Masterson's stance on data centers
slots.sentence: He supports a Kansas version of the White House’s position on data centers — a voluntary commitment designed to prevent them from driving up utility bills.
